verses.english: “There are, mendicants, these two kinds of happiness.
Happiness with rapture and happiness free of rapture.
These are the two kinds of happiness.

verses.pali: Etadaggaṁ, bhikkhave, imesaṁ dvinnaṁ sukhānaṁ yadidaṁ nippītikaṁ sukhan”ti.
verses.english: The better of these two kinds of happiness is happiness free of rapture.”
